data.name: Beast Handler
data.water_note: Path 1 (Piranha) requires water within 60 units of the tower (range buffs do not extend this); Path 3 (Gyrfalcon) requires track in range; Path 2 can be bought with no land space.
targeting_extra: Gyrfalcon line uses a targetable reticle for grab/drop point
data.beast_power_mechanic: Each tier adds Beast Power; merging Beast Handlers (same beast type, tier 4+ merge up to power cap) scales damage/pierce/attack speed. Power scales: T1 1; T2 3-6; T3 8-24; T4 16-64; T5 36-132 (default 84 with 3 extra T4 merged).
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0. Tier 5 requires 3 additional merged tier-4 handlers of the same beast.

1.name: Piranha
1.text: Replaces staff attack with leaping piranha. Only purchasable with water within 60 units.

1.name: Barracuda
1.text: Barracuda: range 25->35, pierce 1->4-12, damage 1->2-4, splash radius 4->8, knocks bloons back 50% for 0.2s (25% for Lead/Ceramic). Merges improve pierce, damage, attack speed.

1.name: Great White
1.text: Jumps out of water at intervals, latches onto a bloon (incl. Lead, MOAB-class) and thrashes. Drags target into water if it can be one-shot; else latches up to 3s. At max power can drag a MOAB.

1.name: Orca

stats.drag_time_formula: RemainingHP/120 s, min 1 max 6 for MOAB/BFB

1.text: Thrash radius 15->24, dmg 30-90, pierce 20-60, knockback +50% duration/strength. Drags all bloon types 1s; MOAB/BFB by RemainingHP/120s (1-6s). At max power drags ZOMGs and visible DDTs.

1.name: Megalodon
1.text: Requires 3 additional merged Orca handlers. Thrash radius 48, damage 600-1800, pierce 50-90, MOAB-class dragged much faster, can drag BADs (max 30s vs 6s).

2.name: Microraptor
2.text: Replaces staff with microraptor claw attack. Can be bought with zero land space.

2.name: Adasaurus
2.text: Damage 1->2-4, pierce 5->8-20, radius 10->15, Normal damage (pops Lead). Merges boost damage, pierce, speed.

2.name: Velociraptor
2.text: Range 24, bite radius 18, damage 4-16, pierce 12-26, x1.5 damage vs stunned, +4 Ceramic.

2.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
2.text: Bites damage 20-60. T-Rex Stomp ability: radius 100 blast, stuns regular 6s, MOAB/BFB 3s, ZOMG/DDT 2s (not BADs/Bosses), cooldown 40s down to 19.03s at max power. At power 64 attacks penetrate blimp layers.

2.name: Giganotosaurus
2.text: Requires 3 additional merged T-Rex handlers. Sees over obstacles, penetrates blimp layers at any power. Stomp covers whole screen.

3.name: Gyrfalcon
3.text: Bird controlled by reticle: scratches bloons closer to entrance than reticle; grabs bloons further than reticle and carries to drop-off while damaging each second. Needs track in range to buy. Popped bloons lose children. Can't target Ceramic+ or Lead without lead-popping. Pierce/rate not buffable.

3.name: Horned Owl
3.text: Camo detection, better pierce/radius; grabs Ceramics (+4 pierce each). Merges raise attack speed, pierce, flight speed; damage 1->2 at max power. Intel range from merged handlers anywhere on map.

3.name: Golden Eagle
3.text: Pierce 30-90, damage 1-3, grab radius 25, no Lead penalty, Ceramic cost +1. At power 24 can grab MOABs (cost +1089 pierce, overflow allowed). Grabbed MOAB popped mid-flight spawns no children.

3.name: Giant Condor
3.text: Damage 2-6, +11 vs MOAB-class, grabs BFBs and DDTs (if Lead countered). Power 64 can damage (not grab) BADs and Bosses; cannot affect ZOMGs.

3.name: Pouākai
3.text: Requires 3 additional merged Giant Condor handlers. Normal damage, damage 10-90, +80 MOAB-class, pierce 150-450, grabs ZOMGs; BADs/Bosses targetable but only take scratch damage. No flight speed penalty.

data.paragon_note: No Beast Handler paragon on wiki.
